candidates.change_summary: Remove the overflow check requirement, allowing Deposit to proceed even when balances[msg.sender] + msg.value would overflow, which changes final balance value.
Remove the balance increment statement so Deposit() no longer increases the caller's balance.
Replace 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value' with 'balances[msg.sender] = msg.value', overwriting the balance instead of adding to it.
Replace 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value' with 'balances[msg.sender] += 0', preventing any balance increase on deposit.
Replace 'require(((balances[msg.sender] + msg.value) >= balances[msg.sender]))' with 'require(false)', causing Deposit() to always revert.
Insert 'balances[msg.sender] = 0;' before the existing balance increment, resetting balance to zero before adding msg.value.
Replace 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value' with 'balances[address(0)] += msg.value', crediting deposit to zero address instead of caller.
